title: What came between Papal States and Grand Duchy of Tuscany?
question: What came between Papal States and Grand Duchy of Tuscany?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Papal States (754) to Grand Duchy of Tuscany (1569): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: territories mostly in the Appenine Peninsula under the sovereign direct rule of the pope between 756–1870
